schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE R (A1 INT, A2 INT, A3 INT);
q1: SELECT DISTINCT * FROM R AS X WHERE X.A1 = X.A2 AND X.A2 = X.A3
q2: SELECT DISTINCT * FROM R AS X WHERE X.A1 = X.A2 AND X.A1 = X.A3
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT * FROM R AS X WHERE X.A1 = X.A2 AND X.A2 = X.A3
